purpose: Numerical recovery of final-comparison SARIMAX fits; selected forecasting model and information set remain fixed
defined_after: Five core refits and clipped-input SARIMAX failed the original bounded L-BFGS policy. A derivative-free Powell initialization produced nonfinite likelihoods and was rejected without forecast scoring; its exact code/policy/logs are archived under recovery_attempts/powell_v1.
scope: Failed core or controlled-ablation SARIMAX fits with validation-selected orders. Preserve original failures. Do not reopen validation-based configuration selection or choose a solver by test error.
initial_parameters: Earlier converged core_sarimax_frozen_s42 fit, whose cutoff is no later than the task cutoff. Convert regressor slope initialization for input scale changes; initialize any additional regressors at zero. This vector initializes optimization only; all parameters are estimated again.
acceptance: Final optimizer convergence, finite likelihood/parameters, training likelihood no worse than the original failed point (1e-5 tolerance), and complete finite aligned predictions. Otherwise preserve unresolved failure.
resource_accounting: Include original failed fit, rejected Powell attempt, and current recovery. Identify shared initial fits separately.
interpretation: Recorded numerical-policy amendment after solver failures; changes initialization/derivative precision/line search, not forecasting orders or test-based model selection. Label recovered coverage transparently.
